history.notes: Initial release
Bug fixes
Performance improvements
Added bulk decompressor
Translation support
Cloud downloader improvements
Watchlist enhancements
Auto-retry cap, completion reports, smart updater, in-app tutorial
Bulk decompressor (new tab), auto-retry cap (5 attempts), desktop completion reports, smart in-app updater, tutorial modal, version database

Google Drive overhaul: fixed fuzzy crash, quota exceeded detection, full folder support, all URL patterns, live progress. Persistent per-session logs in logs/ folder. Settings UI cleanup: removed bottom version label, coloured version numbers, added Logs Folder button.

Fixed critical NoneType crash in Google Drive downloader (sys.stdout=None in windowed builds). Real filenames now resolved via gdown skip_download before download. Removed invalid gdown 6.x parameters (fuzzy, remaining_ok). Added _suppress_gdown_output guard, resume support, progress callback wiring, and centralised quota-error HTML page detection.

Watchlist overhaul: fixed global download directory overriding artist folders, saved per-artist filter settings for updates, fixed Windows cross-drive path crashes & double-folder nesting. Added Download All Updates, Add Artist by URL modal, interactive post review with per-post/bulk ignoring, editable last-downloaded cutoff date with smart auto-normalization, live search & service filter, click-to-open folder, Newtonian spring physics animations, and QML responsive layout fixes.

Bunkr 2026 infrastructure overhaul: support for modern domains (bunkr.cr, bunkr.si, bunkr.pk, balbums.st, etc.), dynamic signed token minting via /sign, ?advanced=1 structured album catalog parser, and multi-threaded media resolution. Unicode & Mojibake repair engine: automatic Latin-1/CP1252 recovery, hidden zero-width spaces (\ufeff BOM, \u200b) stripping, and Windows-safe filename sanitization. Added Desktop completion report toggle in Settings under Storage & File Processing.

Post date range filtering with full date, year-month, and year-only support, auto-page scanning, and early-stop. Duplicate file detection preventing redundant downloads of files mirrored in both post headers and attachments. Full 14-language localization for the interactive tutorial. Scrollable tabs navigation indicators with edge fade chevrons and persistent scrollbar hint. Fixed crash when toggling thumbnail-only or skip-covers settings.

Bulk Decompressor overhaul: encrypted archive password prompt modal with wrong-password shake animation and password bank auto-sync, collapsible creator-grouped Password Bank with active target matching highlights, parallel extraction serialisation (one modal at a time), disk space pre-flight check, already-extracted detection with amber colour-coding and re-extract confirmation modal, ghost folder prevention via 7za test-before-extract. Spring-physics (Newtonian) animations on all modals. Auto-password from Link Vault (WIP).

Dedicated Archive tab with offline post and file cataloging, disk verification engine, missing file highlights & cleanup, collapsible overview header, and fluid virtual scrolling. Interactive Post Selector & Inspector with Grid/List modes, full descriptions, attachment checkboxes, dynamic selection counters, and fullscreen Lightbox visualizer. Interactive custom filename template builder with tag chips and live preview. Multi-drive storage overflow tracking and smart disk balancing. Temporary oversized file downloads (t1.pawchive.pw) with expiration tracking. Complete 14-language interactive tutorial guides for all new features.

Polite Pawchive server protection: single continuous resumable stream for Pawchive, gentle inter-file pacing (250-400ms), and relaxed API pagination delays. Embedded audio metadata tagger (ID3v2.3, Vorbis, MP4) for MP3, FLAC, M4A, OGG, and WAV. Queue batch cancellation fixes, Retry modal failed-task clearing, and smooth scroll fixes across Queue, Archive, and Retry modals. Custom min/max file size filtering.

Archive tab performance overhaul: folded artist and post file-trees by default with lazy-loading for instantaneous loading with 10k-100k+ files. Extreme scale optimizations: O(1) Queue lookups, indexed archive queries, and throttled history writes. Download integrity & hash fixes: verified raw downloads before post-processing, excluded MP4 video files from audio tagger, and disabled audio tagging by default.

Console Log selection overhaul: multi-row continuous drag selection, auto-scrolling, keyboard range navigation, clipboard copy fixes, and right-click context menu. Stream video SHA-256 verification fixes.

Character recognition overhaul with optional offline AI assistant (Fast Multilingual Matcher + Deep Reasoner SLM), in-app model downloader with real-time speed & progress, live recognition test sandbox, cloud link keyword filtering & subfolder sorting (Mega, GDrive, Dropbox, GoFile), Watchlist update auto-resolution, and archive self-healing migration.

Favorite Mode for downloading account favorites, exact file extension filtering with quick-pick chips, character recognition overhaul with franchise-first folder hierarchy (Series/Character), full-resolution download priority with opt-in thumbnail fallback & automatic low-res replacement (#19), instant cancellation for large downloads (100k+ tasks), fix download state and missing Cancel button after stopping a previous session, omnibox page range fix (max page defaults to blank/all), and encrypted credentials vault.
